subject: english-studies
title: Active and passive voice
summary: Turn a sentence around so the focus is on what was done, not who did it.

lesson.text: In the active voice, the subject does the action: The farmer planted the maize. In the passive voice, the subject receives the action: The maize was planted by the farmer.
How to change active to passive

items: Move the object (the maize) to the front as the new subject.
Use a form of "be" in the same tense as the active verb (is, are, was, were, will be, has been).
Add the past participle of the main verb (planted, written, eaten).
Add "by" + the doer, or leave it out if it doesn't matter.

lesson.title: The cat chased the rat.
steps: Object "the rat" moves to the front.
The rat was chased by the cat.

lesson.title: The prefect rings the bell every morning.
steps: The bell is rung by the prefect every morning.

lesson.title: Somebody has stolen my phone.
steps: The doer (somebody) is unknown, so leave it out.

lesson.text: Use it when the doer is unknown or unimportant, or in reports and science: "The water was boiled for five minutes." Otherwise the active voice is usually clearer.
Only sentences with an object can become passive. "The baby slept" has no object, so it has no passive form.

questions.prompt: Change to passive: "Ada wrote the letter."
options: The letter is written by Ada.
The letter was written by Ada.
The letter was wrote by Ada.
questions.explanation: Wrote is past, so use was + past participle written. "Was wrote" uses the past tense instead of the participle.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
options: Our scripts were marked by the teacher.
The teacher will mark our scripts.
questions.explanation: The subject (our scripts) receives the action, and the verb is were + marked.

questions.prompt: Change to passive: "They will build a new hospital."
options: A new hospital will be built.
A new hospital will be build.
questions.explanation: Future tense: will be + past participle (built). The doer "they" is vague, so it can be left out.

questions.prompt: Which sentence cannot be changed into the passive voice?
questions.explanation: "Laughed" has no object here, so there is nothing to move to the front. The others all have an object.

questions.prompt: Change to active: "The windows are cleaned by the gateman."
options: The gateman is cleaned the windows.
questions.explanation: "Are cleaned" is present, so the active verb is present too: cleans. "Cleaned" would change the tense.
